## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 389 captures during April 2019. The activity reflects the imaging completed at the site over the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no other disruption noted in the operational summary. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting period.

## Image quality

There were 14 ungradable captures. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.6 per cent. The rate is reported alongside the total number of captures to provide context for the image-quality result. These figures identify the images that could not be graded and support routine monitoring of image acquisition at Harbour Eye Clinic.

## Grading

A total of 61 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 7 days. This measure summarises the time between image submission and grading across the reporting period. Together, the referable result count and the median grading wait describe the grading outcome and service timeliness for April 2019.
